messages:
ravi: Primeway dry-run tomorrow 11:00 PT — pre-cutover checklist: we need final KMS key ARN, cross-account IAM role names, and confirmation of SIEM ingest endpoint. Can you paste current egress ACLs? @primeway-sre

primeway-sre: thanks. KMS arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777:key/abcd-ef01. Cross-account role: RedwoodAccessRole-Primeway. SIEM: https://siem.primeway.example/ingest . egress: will paste below.

avery: FYI we saw split-horizon DNS issue during test; add internal A record for `redwood-api.private.primeway.local` -> 10.4.2.12

sofia: also confirm audit logs will stream to their S3 bucket with object lock disabled? We recommended object lock off for log rotation. Customer ok? :thinking_face:

primeway-sre: will check on object lock, but retention policy must be 90d. We'll confirm by EOD. Egress ACLs: allow 10.4.0.0/16 -> 52.11.22.0/24:443; 10.4.1.0/24 -> 3.7.8.0/24:443

ravi: thanks — can you also share the IAM trust policy for RedwoodAccessRole-Primeway? we need to validate sts:AssumeRole principal. sample below:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-deploy"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```

primeway-sre: pasted. trust policy looks fine. We'll rotate the KMS key next week per compliance. Heads up, rotation window during cutover may require key-access fallback. :rotating_light:

sofia: renewal note — Primeway is at month 10 of 12 trial. If cutover completes without support escalations we'll propose renewing with Dedicated trial discount. flagging sales. :money_with_wings:

ravi: perfect. quick ask: can ops run a smoke test script after cutover? use command:

`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://redwood-api.private.primeway.local/healthz`

primeway-sre: will run and post results in this thread after dry-run. :thumbsup:
